title: Hue vs Hoi An: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Hue for history, food, and budget. Hoi An for atmosphere, tailoring, and lantern-lit evenings. Do both via the Hai Van Pass.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Hue wins on royal cuisine tradition and Bun Bo Hue. Hoi An wins on Cao Lau, White Rose dumplings, and Banh Mi Phuong.

categories.name: History & Culture
categories.summary: Hue's Imperial Citadel and 7 royal tombs are Vietnam's most significant pre-modern heritage sites.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Hue is 15-25% cheaper overall. Mid-range day: Hue 600k-1M VND vs Hoi An 800k-1.5M VND.

categories.name: Atmosphere
categories.summary: Hoi An's lantern-lit Ancient Town at dusk is one of Southeast Asia's most beautiful evening experiences.

categories.name: Tailoring
categories.summary: Hoi An has 400+ tailor shops and is Vietnam's custom clothing capital.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Hue offers DMZ tours, Bach Ma NP, and royal tombs. Hoi An is closer to My Son Sanctuary.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Hoi An's Ancient Town is fully walkable. Hue requires motorbike or Grab to visit spread-out tombs.

categories.name: Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: February-April is optimal for both. Avoid October-November (typhoon/flooding risk).

categories.name: Crowding
categories.summary: Hue feels like a real Vietnamese city. Hoi An's Old Town gets crowded with day-trippers.

categories.name: Evening Atmosphere
categories.summary: Hoi An's paper lanterns at night are extraordinary. Hue has a more local bar scene.

faq.question: Is Hue or Hoi An better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Hoi An is more iconic for first-timers. Serious history lovers should prioritize Hue. Ideally, do both.

faq.question: How far is Hue from Hoi An?
faq.answer: 130km, about 3 hours by car. The Hai Van Pass scenic drive is one of Vietnam's great travel experiences.

faq.question: Which is cheaper — Hue or Hoi An?
faq.answer: Hue is 15-25% cheaper overall. Mid-range hotel in Hue 400k-900k VND vs Hoi An 600k-1.5M VND.
